reopen_history.reason:
Downstream SQL-on-FHIR consumers join derived tables on getResourceKey() resource keys, which this port drops at
  the outermost SELECT. The attempt adds the manifest's declared key_columns (patient_key, encounter_key, specimen_key).
  Change only the outermost projection: leave value expressions, casts and ViewDefinition column names as they are, so
  that identical comparison figures remain proof the change was inert.
reopen_history.superseded_justification: Judge accepted the attributed divergence: mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_observation_labevents.sql:15,121 casts labevents.charttime through TIMESTAMPTZ before writing Observation.effectiveDateTime, exactly the FHIR path used by the port. The sole conflict (1/117,898; 0.00085%) replayed completely as the America/New_York DST spring-forward normalization, consistent with DST-gap rarity and unrecoverable from FHIR; 117,897 rows otherwise matched.

reopen_history.reason: [replay:data_rebuild] The MIMIC-on-FHIR warehouse was rebuilt on 2026-08-24 after two upstream data defects were fixed: FHIR resources are now generated under UTC, so wall-clock timestamps are no longer shifted an hour across the spring-forward boundary, and Patient.birthDate is now derived from the anchor year and age rather than from the first transfer. This port was carried forward byte-identical to re-measure it against the corrected data -- do not re-author it. Expect previously accepted divergences to have shrunk or gone; if an hour-wide shift still appears, treat it as a finding and establish why the correction did not reach that path rather than accepting it as an upstream artifact.
reopen_history.superseded_justification: Judge accepted the attributed divergence: the port reads Observation.effectiveDateTime via (effective).ofType(dateTime) and preserves the served wall value with TIMESTAMP_NTZ. mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_observation_labevents.sql:15 casts labevents.charttime through TIMESTAMPTZ and :121 serializes that transformed value as Observation.effectiveDateTime; the parallel specimen path is also transformed at mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_specimen_lab.sql:18,58. The comparator exhaustively replayed the sole charttime conflict as the America/New_York spring-forward normalization with zero residual. The affected fraction is 1/117,898 (0.000848%), consistent with DST-gap rarity, and the original wall time is unrecoverable from FHIR. All other 117,897 rows match and no essential representation loss remains.
